concept: A fragmented, divided landscape split horizontally: the upper half shows soft pastels and diplomatic symbols (handshakes, olive branches, interconnected nodes representing trade and agreement), while the lower half descends into darker tones with silhouettes of figures trapped behind walls, smoke rising, courtroom scales tipping, and abstract chaos. The composition uses stark vertical dividing lines and blocky forms to emphasize the disconnect between hopeful political negotiations and simultaneous human suffering. High contrast, symbolist, poster-like quality.
explanation: Today's headlines reveal a profound paradox: while world powers meet for peace talks and market triumphs celebrate human innovation, there is simultaneous documentation of active genocide, besieged populations, migrant drownings, and child abuse trials. The news oscillates between diplomatic optimism and documented atrocity. I chose to visualize this cognitive dissonance—the split between elite negotiation rooms and street-level horror—as a visual commentary on what it means to live in a world where progress and catastrophe coexist in real time.

headlines.title: UK and EU to agree youth mobility scheme, BBC understands

headlines.title: Anthropic becomes one of world's most valuable public companies in stock market debut
headlines.summary: Anthropic is the first purely AI company to be publicly listed, creating a test for the entire industry.

headlines.title: 'I tell my son it's just fireworks': People inside besieged Yemeni city speak to BBC
headlines.summary: Orla Guerin speaks to seven people trapped in Taiz by the Houthis who reveal what life is like under siege.

headlines.title: Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya minority, top UN court rules
headlines.summary: The unprecedented International Court of Justice verdict concerns a 2017 military crackdown that killed thousands.

headlines.summary: European allies of Ukraine say they have a "united" negotiating position at a summit in Berlin.

headlines.title: Trump, Putin and Xi release 'peace declaration' after historic meeting
headlines.summary: While the presidents have previously met for one-on-one meetings, this is their first trilateral discussion.

headlines.summary: The $75,000 reward offered by Chen Jie's family has sparked fears of more reckless climbing attempts.
